Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		usersWithOverdue: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|Loan.allInstance()->exists(l|l.LoanedUser = u and
		(l.OverDue3Days = true or
		l.OverDue10Days = true or
		l.OverDue17Days = true or
		l.OverDue31Days = true)))
	precondition:
		usersWithOverdue.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		usersWithOverdue->forAll(u: User|if u.SuspensionDays@pre>0 
		then u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre-1 and
		if u.SuspensionDays@pre = 1 
		then u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND 
		else true 
		endif  
		else true 
		endif )
}
